flags: The inherited root EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md called a roughly 0.42% bid/ask gap the one-way conversion cost, repeated superseded emigrant staging, and described willful FBAR exposure as per year. Those statements are not carried into the consolidated summary. A bid/ask gap is not a measured one-way customer loss; the 2014 amendment controls staging; penalty application depends on the violation.
J02 · Exact personal all-in cost remains unverified

Source-of-funds, bank classification, CNY basis/acquisition dates, PRC and U.S. tax history, receiving bank, actual transfer count, executable FX and document quotes were not supplied. All-in and personal-tax cells remain blank. Blank never means zero.
J03 · Indicative quote, not an execution offer

The consolidated scenario uses BOC's USD100 ask CNY669.03 at 2026-11-10 07:32:39 China time. BOC says actual transaction-channel rates control. The ask was below its displayed reference rate, so no positive FX 'spread cost' is inferred. Edition H's prior-day grids use CNY669.19 and are retained unchanged.
J04 · Known sender fee is not a total

BOC overseas charges are actual; its full-arrival option is conditional. HSBC excludes other institutions' and government charges. Intermediate and U.S. receiving fees are unknown. Scenario values cover only published sender commission/cable and a comparison-rate conversion.

The 2006 individual measures use ID-based domestic/overseas categories, while the broader FX regulation has a separate residence-based definition. A U.S. citizen with legacy PRC identity documents must resolve the bank's classification rather than assume quota eligibility.

SAFE Hebei's inheritance guide repeats emigrant pre-status wording in its eligibility section even though its definition and document checklist concern inherited property. It is flagged verbatim rather than silently rewritten; the competent SAFE office must confirm the current local checklist.
J07 · Wise eligibility and grid limitations

Wise from-CNY requires qualifying non-mainland status, China work/tax history, own-account destination and an after-tax-income overall limit. Its bank-app and Alipay caps can force multiple transfers. No current 40-point fee schedule was verified, so Wise grid values remain blank in Edition H.

Western Union's checked China page says bank-account payout is temporarily unavailable and offers cash pickup through partner banks. No fee or FX amount is inferred. MoneyGram/PayPal and other unsupported own-account CNY corridors stay unverified in the inherited catalog.
J09 · Cash is not a large-balance workaround

China generally restricts carrying more than USD10,000 cash abroad to specified special cases with SAFE permission; U.S. entry/exit above USD10,000 requires declaration. ATM caps and transport/deposit risks apply. No splitting instructions are provided.
J10 · Archived editions are evidence, not certification

The consolidated method catalog links Edition H's 43 candidates, steps and 1,720 amount rows. This integration directly re-read the load-bearing sources listed in its evidence log and ran all edition checkers. It does not claim a fresh legal opinion on every archived line or guarantee external-link uptime.

MOF/STA 2026 No. 27 applies 20% IIT to foreign individuals' FIE dividends from 2026-09-01 and repeals the specified old exemption. Older archived exemptions are stale. Treaty and beneficial-owner analysis remains case-specific.
PBOC Yinfa [2026] No. 42 expressly repealed the 2021 virtual-currency notice. Older archives citing only the 2021 instrument retain historical text but are not the consolidated authority.
J13 · Audit scope and historical links

A follow-up audit independently checked selected primary sources and corrected a mechanical test that could skip data rows without any links. The consolidated pages now require a source on every data row; a source link alone does not prove every claim. Archived editions were not re-certified line by line, and some archival official links use HTTP. The comparison rate is historical, not a live execution quote. See the audit record for exact scope and outstanding limitations.
